# project-demo-video-skill

> An Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that lets a coding agent produce a narrated, captioned 1080p demo video (under 3 minutes) of any software project or hackathon entry, as code, with Playwright and ffmpeg. Real app, real proof output, real code, honest labels. ElevenLabs voice is optional.

## Skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/learnermaker/project-demo-video-skill/main/skills/project-demo-video/SKILL.md): rules, phases, pipeline, pitfalls, QA checklist
- [templates/final.mjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/learnermaker/project-demo-video-skill/main/skills/project-demo-video/templates/final.mjs): orchestrator
- [templates/narration.mjs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/learnermaker/project-demo-video-skill/main/skills/project-demo-video/templates/narration.mjs): script format
